idea.title: The wrong kind of speech
idea.summary: Fiction: a best man rehearses his wedding speech on a stranger who hears it as a goodbye, then helps him fix the ending.
hookOptions: A man read his wedding speech to a stranger, and she cried.
She cried at a speech that wasn't sad.
Best man, one night, no audience.
He rehearsed on a stranger by mistake.

scenes.say: A man read his wedding speech to a stranger, and she started crying.
The night before, the best man had a messy stack of cards and no audience.

scenes.name: Wobbly Lantern

messages.text: Tomorrow my best friend's life changes forever.
oh no. are you ok? i'm so sorry
He's marrying Meera. I'm the speech guy.

scenes.say: He practised on a random call, and she heard a breakup speech.
She laughed, then fixed his ending, and the next day the whole room cried properly.

scenes.name: Mellow Kite
scenes.say: Nervous about something? Say it out loud to someone who's never heard it.
